statement: ∀ (a : ℂ), a ∈ LR.J p M y v 0 → a ≠ 0 → ∀ (g : ℂ), g ∈ LR.J p M y v 0 → ∃ q : ℚ, g = (q : ℂ) * a
proof:
intro a ha ha0 g hg
rcases h_T009 with ⟨mu, hmu, hminj, hmrange, hmfin⟩
letI := hmfin
let ta : TensorProduct (LR.R p) ℚ (LR.J p M y v 0) := TensorProduct.tmul (LR.R p) 1 ⟨a, ha⟩
have hta : mu ta = a := by simpa [ta] using hmu 1 ⟨a, ha⟩
have hta0 : ta ≠ 0 := by
  intro hz
  apply ha0
  rw [← hta, hz, map_zero]
have hr : Module.finrank ℚ (TensorProduct (LR.R p) ℚ (LR.J p M y v 0)) = 1 := h_T010.2
obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := (finrank_eq_one_iff_of_nonzero' ta hta0).mp hr (TensorProduct.tmul (LR.R p) 1 (⟨g, hg⟩ : LR.J p M y v 0))
have heq : q • a = g := by
  have hh := congrArg mu hq
  simpa only [map_smul, hta, hmu, one_smul] using hh
exact ⟨q, by simpa only [Rat.smul_def, Algebra.smul_def] using heq.symm⟩
